sources.entry: Kapowarr - Build and manage a comic book library. Download, rename, move and convert issues of the volume to your liking. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Kapowarr is a self-hosted comic book library manager in the *arr style that searches for, downloads, renames, moves and converts comic issues and volumes.
summary.what_it_does: Kapowarr lets you add comic volumes and map them to a folder on disk. It can run a "Search Monitored" to download whole volumes in one click, or a "Manual Search" so you choose what to download. The README says it handles issues including TPBs, One Shots and Hard Covers, and that downloads are moved to a chosen location and renamed in a chosen format. Archive files can be extracted and renamed after download or with a single click. You can also import an existing library into it. The README says downloads use DDL, Pixeldrain, Mega and many other services, and the whole process is automated and configurable in settings.
use_cases: Automate downloading a comic series volume by volume
Organize and rename an existing comic collection
Import an existing comic library into a manager
Extract and rename comic archive files
Convert downloaded comic issues to a different format
Manually pick which comic issues to download
how_to_run: See the installation documentation linked in the README (not reproduced in the README text provided)
notable: Fits the *arr suite of tools and uses a similar UI
Search Monitored for one-click whole-volume downloads
Supports TPBs, One Shots and Hard Covers
Imports an existing library and renames files on move
Supports DDL, Pixeldrain, Mega and other download services
caveats: README does not include install steps; refers to external documentation
README does not list supported operating systems beyond saying all major ones are supported
